question: How much foreign exchange revenue has ISRO generated through satellite launches from 2015 to 2024?
solution:
The Correct Answer is __**143 million US dollars**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__**

__
 
• ISRO Earns $143 Million from Foreign Satellite Launches.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__**

 
• The **Indian Space Research Organisation (ISRO)** generated **nearly 143 million US dollars** in **foreign exchange revenue** through satellite launches.
 
• **ISRO launched a total of 393 foreign satellites** and **3 Indian customer satellites** on a commercial basis between **January 2015 and December 2024**.
 
• These satellites were launched aboard **ISRO’s PSLV**, **LVM3**, and **SSLV launch vehicles**.
 
• **ISRO** has launched satellites for **34 countries**, including developed nations such as the **United States**, **United Kingdom**, and **Singapore**.
